d: At the launch of the Cockroach Janata Party's (CJP) 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign in Goa, founder Abhijeet Dipke called for the scrapping of Section 39A, warning that Goa risks losing its identity if it remains in place. Accusing politicians and builders of taking away people's land, traditions and culture, Dipke raised concerns over the proposed 130-acre township project, water scarcity and the lack of educational and employment opportunities for Goan youth. He also urged Goans to unite beyond caste, religion and political ideologies, calling for collective action to protect their land,…
